brief: How we got our first 100 customers — no ads, no SEO, just 6 channels.

slots.author: NexaLaunch
slots.headline: First 100 Customers: No Ads, No SEO
slots.body: We skipped the paid playbook entirely. Here are the six organic channels that actually moved the needle for our startup.

slots.author: NexaLaunch
slots.title: LinkedIn Direct Outreach
slots.body: We sent 30 personalized DMs daily to our ICP. No automation, just genuine conversations that converted.

slots.author: NexaLaunch
slots.title: Twitter Daily Engagement
slots.body: We replied to 50 relevant tweets every single day. Value-first comments built trust and drove profile clicks.

slots.author: NexaLaunch
slots.title: Niche Reddit Communities
slots.body: We joined subreddits where our users already hung out. Answered questions and softly mentioned our solution.

slots.author: NexaLaunch
slots.title: Product Hunt Launch
slots.body: A well-timed launch brought a surge of early adopters. We prepped our hunter list and demo video weeks ahead.

slots.author: NexaLaunch
slots.title: Early Customer Referrals
slots.body: We gave existing users a free month for every signup they brought in. It turned customers into advocates.

slots.author: NexaLaunch
slots.title: Strategic Tool Partnerships
slots.body: We integrated with complementary tools and co-marketed to their user bases. Shared audiences multiplied our reach overnight.
